name: Steppe Bandits
composition: A ragged band of three or four riders, more interested in your cargo than a fair fight.

name: Fen Raiders
composition: Raiders who know the reed channels better than you do, striking fast and low.

name: Rival Caravan Guard
composition: A hired sword protecting a competitor's wagon, none too pleased to see you on the same road.

name: Orc Raiders
composition: A war-band out from the wildlands, testing the roads ahead of something larger.

name: Vrakthar the Unbound
composition: The warlord who united the wildland tribes stands at the gate of his stronghold, his war-band arrayed behind him.
telegraph: Word reaches the Enforcers: Vrakthar's horde is marching on the trade roads. This is the fight the whole campaign has been building toward.

name: The Brazen Warden
composition: A magically-animated construct of bronze and warded iron, still trailing scaffolding from its unfinished forging.
telegraph: The Order of the Arcane's construct isn't finished being empowered yet — this is the only window to stop it before it is.

name: Kestra Vane, the Unbeaten
composition: The champion of a rival company, here to settle who really runs the contract board — no politics, just a duel.
telegraph: Kestra Vane has called you out by name. No escorts, no tricks — the guild's dominance rides on this alone.

name: Threnval, the Ashen Wyrm
composition: An ancient dragon, roused from a centuries-long sleep by treasure hunters who didn't heed the old warnings.
telegraph: The Order has tracked Threnval to its lair. Whatever happens next, the world changes after this.
